Definition: a Zebulonite or descendant of Zebulun
BiblicalUsage: Zebulonite names a member of the tribe of Zebulun, counted in the wilderness census at more than sixty thousand fighting men. The word also marks Elon, who judged Israel for ten years and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a tribe's name is a promise kept, because Zebulun's sons were still counted and still judging generations after Jacob blessed them.
